sentences.cs: Tomáš bydlí v Praze a nemá auto.
sentences.en: Tomáš lives in Prague and doesn't have a car.
He travels to the centre by tram.
The stop is in front of his house.
In the morning he waits there for five minutes.

sentences.cs: Tramvaj číslo dvacet dva jede do centra.
sentences.en: Tram number twenty-two goes to the centre.

sentences.cs: Ráno je v tramvaji hodně lidí.
sentences.en: In the morning there are a lot of people on the tram.
Tomáš stands, because he has no seat.

sentences.cs: Dívá se z okna na řeku a na starý most.
sentences.en: He looks out of the window at the river and the old bridge.

sentences.cs: Za dvacet minut vystupuje v centru.
sentences.en: In twenty minutes he gets off in the centre.

sentences.cs: Jeho kancelář je vedle staré kavárny.
sentences.en: His office is next to an old café.

sentences.cs: Tam každé ráno pije malé espreso.
sentences.en: There he drinks a small espresso every morning.

sentences.cs: Večer jede Tomáš domů stejnou tramvají.
sentences.en: In the evening Tomáš rides home on the same tram.
